content: If parameter Controller of CanIf_TTGetSyncQuality () has an invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. CANIF_- DEV_ERROR_DETECT equals ON ), the function CanIf_TTGetSyncQuality() shall report development error code CANIF_E_PARAM_CONTROLLER to the Det_Re- portError service of the DET module.
